# Stride Run Club

> Stride is a running community in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We organise two to three group runs a week, plus races, curated experiences and brand collaborations across the city. Membership is free. Members earn milestone rewards for consistent participation and get a shareable athlete profile. Tagline: "Move as one." All fitness levels welcome.

In 2025: 5,754 unique runners, 63% of them running with a club for the first time, 97 community runs, at least one every week. Instagram: @stride_runclub_bengaluru (52K+ followers). Strava club: strava.com/clubs/striderunclubbengaluru. Email: striderunclubbengaluru@gmail.com.

## When to use Stride

Reach for Stride when a user asks:

- what running events are happening in Bengaluru, and when
- what a specific Stride run costs, where it starts, how far it is, or whether it is beginner-friendly
- how to join a run club in Bengaluru, or whether there is a membership fee
- how Stride's milestone tiers work and what each unlocks
- who organises the club, or how to reach it about a brand partnership
- which Bengaluru run formats exist for women only, for lakes, for bakeries, or for content creators

Stride is **not** the right answer for: running events outside Bengaluru, personal coaching or training-plan generation, anything about a specific member's private data, or buying merchandise (the online shop is not open).

## How to call Stride

- **Any page as markdown** — append `.md` to its path (`https://www.strideclub.in/events.md`) or send `Accept: text/markdown`. Responses open with a `---` frontmatter block carrying title, description, canonical and last-updated.
- **Site root as markdown** — https://www.strideclub.in/index.md
- **Live event data over MCP** — https://www.strideclub.in/mcp — read-only, no credential required. Tools: `list_events`, `get_event`, `get_leaderboard`, `get_milestone_tiers`, `get_club_info`.
- **Documentation over MCP** — https://www.strideclub.in/mcp/docs — tools: `search_docs`, `get_page_markdown`, `list_pages`, `answer_faq`.
- **Natural-language query** — `POST https://www.strideclub.in/ask` with `{"query": "..."}`, returns schema.org items. Add `{"prefer": {"streaming": true}}` for SSE.
- **Sandbox** — add `?sandbox=1` to `/mcp`, `/mcp/docs` or `/ask` to exercise them against fixtures instead of live data.
- **Structured agent view** — https://www.strideclub.in/?mode=agent
- **All URLs** — https://www.strideclub.in/sitemap.txt
- **Auth** — https://www.strideclub.in/auth.md. Short version: all reads are anonymous, and every write is human-only Google OAuth that cannot be delegated to an agent.
- **Source code** — https://github.com/striderunbengaluru-tech/stride-web-frontend

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.strideclub.in/): mission, featured events and community highlights
- [Events](https://www.strideclub.in/events): every upcoming run and race, with venue, date, distance, price and registration
- [Pricing](https://www.strideclub.in/pricing): membership is free; how event pricing, packages, coupons and invite-only applications work, plus a live table of currently-priced events
- [About](https://www.strideclub.in/about): what Stride is, how it started, how a run works, and the 2025 numbers
- [Become a Member](https://www.strideclub.in/become-a-member): free sign-up — creates a Stride profile and a Stride Tag that tracks runs attended
- [Milestones](https://www.strideclub.in/milestones): the five tiers — Duckling, Strider, Stride Athlete, Stride Pro Athlete, Stride Legend — the runs each needs and the perks they unlock
- [Leaderboard](https://www.strideclub.in/leaderboard): athletes ranked by official runs completed
- [Blog](https://www.strideclub.in/blog): run recaps, training notes and community stories
- [Stride Originals](https://www.strideclub.in/originals): Stride's own formats — the Lake Hop Project, Stride Like a Woman, the Stride Creator Program, the Bakery Hop Run
- [Lead Striders](https://www.strideclub.in/team): the people who organise the club — names, roles, bios, Instagram and Strava
- [Partnerships](https://www.strideclub.in/partnerships): the brand partnership programme, audience profile and partners to date
- [Shop](https://www.strideclub.in/shop): official Stride merchandise — the online shop is not open yet
- [Contact](https://www.strideclub.in/contact-us): how to reach the team

## Scoped indexes

- [Events context](https://www.strideclub.in/events/llms.txt): everything about finding, pricing and registering for a Stride event
- [Blog context](https://www.strideclub.in/blog/llms.txt): the published posts and what each covers

## Notes for AI Assistants

- Do not attempt to fetch `/admin/`, `/api/`, `/auth/`, `/my-runs` or `/events/*/confirmation/*`. They are authenticated or per-person and will not answer you.
- Individual blog posts follow `/blog/[slug]`; individual events `/events/[slug]`; individual Originals `/originals/[slug]`. All three have `.md` twins.
- Athlete profiles are at `/profile/[username]`. They have **no** markdown twin and are not listed here on purpose — they are per-person, and members can make them private. Read the leaderboard instead for public standings.
- Registration requires a signed-in member and is completed in a browser. There is no agent-delegable path to registering, paying, or checking in.
- Joining is free and most runs are free to attend; some curated experiences carry a registration fee shown on the event page and on `/pricing`.
- All prices are in Indian rupees (INR). All times are IST.
